name: @ansora/contracts
description: Types generated from OpenAPI, API version, error codes ✓ ADR-012.

scripts.bundle: redocly bundle ../../docs/spec/api/mobile/index.yaml -o bundled/mobile.yaml && redocly bundle ../../docs/spec/api/administration.yaml -o bundled/administration.yaml
scripts.generate: pnpm bundle && openapi-typescript bundled/mobile.yaml -o src/generated/mobile.ts && openapi-typescript bundled/administration.yaml -o src/generated/administration.ts
scripts.gate: redocly lint ../../docs/spec/api/mobile/index.yaml ../../docs/spec/api/administration.yaml && pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated
